Cboe Global Markets provides financial infrastructure, trading, clearing, and investment solutions that support markets worldwide. The Associate Software Engineer, Web will design, implement, test, extend, and maintain web applications and user interfaces, while ensuring uptime and resilience for 24x7 services. The role also involves automated testing, incident remediation, code reviews, requirements analysis, documentation, and sprint planning.

Responsibilities
Design, implement, test, extend, and maintain functionality for our web applications and systems. Good Python, JavaScript (React, NextJS), HTML/CSS, and Linux knowledge. Basic understanding of UX and the Cboe Design Systems (Chroma and Contour). Basic understanding of SQL and familiarity with relational databases
Implement automated unit tests and test changes to systems and platform functionality prior to deployment
Contribute to remediation efforts for incidents arising from own changes
Provide input into team sprint planning and participate in periodic team meetings
Participate in peer code reviews. Capable of giving and receiving constructive feedback
Participate in requirements gathering and analysis. Contribute to documentation, technical specifications, and requirements for our data and applications
Demonstrate interest in system and business knowledge and take steps to improve understanding of Cboe's markets and technology. Assertive and detail oriented, with excellent communication skills
Prioritize and manage time effectively across projects in a deadline-driven environment
Demonstrate excellent communication skills. Regular communication with technical colleagues and be a positive representation of software engineering internally and externally
Performs other related duties as required or requested
